detail: Commercial cleaning for office buildings and shopping centres across Sydney
We employ 46 people directly. In peak periods we also use casual cleaners supplied by a labour hire agency.
Our Supplier Code of Conduct, adopted in March 2025, prohibits forced labour, child labour and recruitment fees charged to workers. New suppliers acknowledge it at onboarding.
Our operations manager and two site supervisors completed an online modern slavery awareness module in August 2026.
Workers, including labour hire workers, can raise concerns confidentially with our HR manager or through an anonymous web form, which is explained at site induction.
We have not commissioned third-party social audits of our suppliers.
In July to September 2026 we sent a supplier declaration request to all 13 active suppliers.
